moment.text: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.

previous.text: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.

next.text: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.

fields.primarySubject: The priests of Jerusalem standing still in the temple court, their linen pale among the ash.
fields.action: The priests stand motionless, faces turned downward toward the scattered stones, neither speaking nor moving.
fields.setting: The smoking temple court of ruined Jerusalem, broken stone steps and dust-strewn flagstones beneath a heavy overcast sky.
fields.secondaryElements: Scattered broken weapons and torn sackcloth among the ruins; drifting ash in the air; no radiance or manifestation of God in the scene.
fields.mood: Stunned, hollow silence and guilt-heavy stillness.
fields.timeOfDay: Dim ashen daylight at the grey edge of dawn.
fields.composition: Medium-wide view from the court's edge, priests placed centrally among the ruined stones, the temple walls receding behind them.
